crossRefs.note: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am…
Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”
I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a…
But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
One who hates and divorces”, says Yahweh, the God of Israel, “covers his garment with violence!” says Yahweh of Armies.…
“For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no…
For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…

translations.web: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
translations.bsb: Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray. I have made you, and I will carry you; I will sustain you and deliver you.
translations.kjv: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver
translations.asv: and even to old age I am he, and even to hoar hairs will I carry you; I have made, and I will bear; yea, I will carry, and will deliver.
